verdict.rationale: Streaming tokens and intermediate events is a fair question for an agent framework, but nothing in the evidence pack documents it. The only run example is a blocking `agent.run()` call, and the Logging feature (traces and internal messages) is an adjacent capability, not real-time streaming to a UI. AutoGen Studio's interactive environment and run control are likewise not documented as event or token streaming.

support.subject: As a developer, I can stream tokens and intermediate agent events (tool calls, steps) to my UI in real time
